title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: Portkey
providers.scope_notes: Covers Portkey (Prisma AIRS AI Gateway). SaaS control plane with hybrid/air-gapped self-hosted options; JWT auth, audit logs and key-permission settings are Enterprise, rotation is on all plans.
controls_unknown: IP allowlisting for API keys or JWTs
Name of the org/workspace maximum key TTL setting
Whether user API keys are disabled when the user is removed or deprovisioned via SCIM
Whether SSO enforcement affects API keys
Whether GET (read) API calls appear in audit logs (filter lists only POST/PUT/DELETE)
Auth cache delay after key deletion

authentication.summary: Bearer token generated in Admin Settings > Authentication Settings > SCIM Provisioning, used by the IdP for user/workspace provisioning.

renewal.summary: Generate a new token in the control plane.

offboard.details: The SCIM token is generated at org level in Admin Settings, not tied to a user's account in the docs.

log_sources.name: Audit Logs
log_sources.notes: Enterprise; Admin Settings > Audit Logs or GET /audit-logs (admin key with audit_logs.list); indefinite retention; filter by user_type=api_key.

log_sources.name: Request Logs
log_sources.notes: Gateway request logs with full request/response; retention 3 days Developer, 30 days Production, unlimited Enterprise.

containment.steps: Regenerate in Admin Settings > Authentication Settings > SCIM Provisioning (revocation of old token not documented).
